Consulting Asha Sah, a dextrous and insightful nutritionist and health guidance expert has significantly improved my understanding of what my body needs to maintain optimal health.
Here are some ways in which she specifically assisted me:
1. Personalized Nutrition Guidance: She created a tailored eating plan based on what was not working for me in my normal routine, to meet my unique health needs, align with my lifestyle, and move closer to my goals.
2. Nutritional Education: She educated me through dialogue and daily narratives on the nutritional value of different foods, helping me make informed choices. I put thought to - macronutrients (proteins, fats, carbohydrates) and micronutrients (vitamins, minerals) in a manner that I could relate to my daily food intact and shift what was being overloaded with too much nonchalance
3. Identifying how I combined my meals: By analysing my diet and looking at my blood work she helped me identify food combinations that could be avoided – so we negotiated with my body’s response by putting to task each set meal and seeing what we could shift and to what time so the same food I was consuming could be had tweaked to suit what my body enjoyed and responded well to.
4. Addressing Food Intolerances: She enabled me to identify how carbs were just not agreeing with me and how I could replace carbs with other food. She assisted me in learning how proteins were healthy as long as I cooked them in a certain proportion and added them to my daily diet. For instance, I specifically realized how gluten was not working, without doing any lab testing and just becoming mindful daily watching how it made me heavy and excessively sleepy and left my body purposeless and struggling for energy for hours.
5. Behavioural and Lifestyle Changes: She had me accept my erratic timings and work schedule that was harming my new journey – I could not adapt to a meal at a specific time, and I still have not – yet I know it’s a goal.
6. Monitoring and Support: Regular consultations with her allowed for ongoing monitoring of my progress and enabled me weekly to shift something specific that was out of line. For instance, eating a Fifth meal after dinner is replaced with eating nuts at night.
7. Thalassemia, is a genetic blood disorder affecting haemoglobin production. I am a minor so I need careful dietary management to improve my blood health and circulation. Working with a nutritionist can be highly beneficial if you are willing to listen to her study of the condition as it relates to food. With a Balanced Diet, designed by Asha, I found I can meet all the supply nutrients essential for my blood health, such as iron, folic acid, vitamin B12, and vitamin C. However, since iron overload is a concern in thalassemia, her diet plan assists me in primarily balancing iron intake. In addition, she suggested Antioxidant-Rich Foods to help reduce oxidative stress, which is common in thalassemia. This includes fruits, vegetables, nuts, and seeds that can improve overall health and blood circulation. Proper hydration is essential for maintaining good blood circulation she insisted on fluids throughout the day.  I have been unable to meet the Meal Timing suggested by her, yet I have managed to find a correct meal Frequency regulation daily so I can help maintain stable energy levels and improve nutrient absorption, which is beneficial for my blood health.

Overall, Asha provided an excellent insight into my routine dietary plan, and with her guidance, I hope to listen to my body and begin the second phase of my work with her: losing weight. In this manner, I believe anyone can benefit if you are not looking for a miracle but looking to connect with your body’s wisdom and teach it to self-regulate itself.
